result.brief: 发布20万级具身导航规划数据集，并以视频世界模型作为低成本环境代理进行交互式强化学习后训练，提升开放世界具身智能体的规划与分布外泛化能力。
result.reason: Uses a video world model as environment proxy for embodied navigation RL post-training, plus a large embodied planning dataset; main contribution is embodied agent training rather than representation.
